ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white to 35% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central medial regions consist of contiguous high-intensity white fields. Dense low-intensity black mottling and pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal tips and along the entire perimeter of the trailing edge, with significant infiltration of dark pixels into the white field on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted from the distal tips toward the central axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-4 pixels in diameter) localized within the dark pigmentation of the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel dark curvilinear pixel tracks (rake marks) oriented vertically within the high-intensity white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of at least four parallel dark linear scars on the medial-right lobe surface.
